support.notes: Localized title/description, primary/secondary action slots, size and explicit geometry, shadow, custom icon, exact theme-resolved SVG illustration and Inbox paths rendered through native Image. Real-device SVG data-URI support has not been verified on every native host. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.
